_comment: Banned terms for leverupliquidity.com. Read by scripts/guard.mjs on every build and by `node scripts/guard.mjs --text <file>` for drafts. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions, matched case-insensitively against visible text, titles, meta and Open Graph/Twitter text, JSON-LD values and alt text. Mirrored on the 'Banned terms' tab of the Leverup Claims Register sheet; change this file first, then the sheet. Every allowlist entry must carry a claims-register ID.
source: claude/leverup-website-strategy-problem-first.md: Guardrails every page follows (2, 4); Compliance rules > Rules for every block > Claims (1-6, 9)
